items.title: Gucci แต่งตั้ง Park Bo Gum เป็น Global Brand Ambassador
items.summary: Thai regional edition of L'Officiel reports Gucci's appointment of South Korean actor Park Bo Gum as its newest global brand ambassador, citing his varied filmography and alignment with creative director Demna's vision for the house. Park said he looks forward to learning the 'aesthetic language' Demna is building.

items.title: Gucci Welcomes the Holidays with Mariah Carey in a Festive New Campaign
items.summary: Singapore lifestyle outlet covers Gucci's 2026 holiday campaign starring Mariah Carey, directed by Harmony Korine, built around her 'All I Want for Christmas Is You' and the new Butterfly collection; piece lists gift items (GG Marmont, Duffle, Starlet bags, Horsebit loafers) being pushed to the regional market for the festive season.

items.title: Fan post on Park Bo Gum x Gucci W Korea cover reposted by Gucci
items.summary: A fan account post (visible engagement activity) reacting to Gucci's official Instagram repost of Park Bo Gum's W Korea Vol. 11 cover, saying the image 'radiates the brand's image so strongly'; representative of SNS buzz volume feeding into the ambassador-announcement wave that reached Southeast Asian fan communities following the Thai press pickup.

items.title: "Extremely cheap Gucci stuff, real or fake?" - HWZ forum thread
items.summary: Singapore community forum thread (active discussion, recent replies within the collection window) where users debate authenticity of suspiciously cheap Gucci items being advertised online, reflecting ongoing consumer wariness about counterfeits and grey-market Gucci goods in the Singapore market.

items.title: Gucci's China shock reverberates across luxury landscape
items.summary: Thai business daily frames Kering's Q3 2026 results (Gucci revenue down 6% comparable, retail sales down 9%, Asia-Pacific down 8% on weak mainland China and Japan footfall) as a bellwether for the wider luxury sector affecting regional retail sentiment, including in Southeast Asian markets exposed to Chinese tourist spending.

items.title: Kering Kehilangan Momentum, Pemulihan Gucci Masih Menjadi Tantangan
items.summary: Indonesian business outlet analyzes Kering Q3 2026 results, noting Gucci revenue of EUR 1.291 billion (down 6% comparable, direct retail down 9%), weak China footfall as the main obstacle, and management's plan for 125 net store closures in 2026; frames the recovery as still unproven, a critical-angle read for the Indonesian market relevant to aspirational-buyer sentiment.
